title: T-3 real-account storage smoke records accountBoundSkipped without env var
asA: operator validating platform-cloudflare-durable-objects v1.0.0 against a real Cloudflare account
iWant: the real-account-storage-smoke probe to record accountBoundSkipped and aggregate to pass when CI_HAS_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT is unset
soThat: the shipped account-bound seam matches the Clerk pattern (skip-in-CI when no account, run when one is available) per spec section 3.5

acceptanceCriteria.description: The real-account-storage-smoke probe with CI_HAS_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT unset returns a single result with anchorAcId AC-33112-1 and verdict pass; the report carries accountBoundSkipped=true and aggregates to pass; exit code 0. With CI_HAS_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT=true but any of CF_ACCOUNT_ID, CF_DO_NAMESPACE_ID or CF_API_TOKEN missing, the probe returns fail naming the missing keys.
acceptanceCriteria.when: run without CI_HAS_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT, and then with the env var but no paired creds
acceptanceCriteria.then: the first run reports accountBoundSkipped and passes; the second reports the missing keys and fails
